description: This file defines the EndsWithBinary class, which is a binary expression node used in Twig templating engine to check if a string ends with a specified substring.

classes.name: EndsWithBinary
classes.description: Represents a binary expression node that checks if the left operand string ends with the right operand string within Twig templates.

methods.name: compile
methods.description: Generates PHP code to evaluate whether the left string ends with the right string using the str_ends_with function.

methods.name: operator
methods.description: Returns an empty raw compiler output; possibly used for operator representation in the node.
